ownership-transfer.label: Vehicle Ownership Transfer
ownership-transfer.description: Transfer vehicle registration into the buyer’s name under Motor Vehicles Act (Forms 29 & 30).

questions.label: What is the vehicle registration number?
questions.placeholder: e.g. DL 01 AB 1234 or MH 12 DE 5678
questions.hint: Enter the exact registration number printed on your RC.

questions.label: What are the last 5 characters of the chassis number?
questions.hint: Found on the vehicle's Registration Certificate (RC).

questions.label: Which state and RTO is the vehicle currently registered in?
questions.hint: Select the parent RTO where vehicle was originally registered.

questions.label: What is the reason / type of ownership transfer?
questions.hint: Standard sale requires Form 29 & 30; inheritance requires legal heir certificate.

questions.label: Is the transfer within the same RTO jurisdiction?
questions.hint: Inter-state transfer requires clearance No Objection Certificate (NOC).

questions.label: What is the full legal name of the buyer (transferee)?
questions.hint: Must match the buyer's official Aadhaar or PAN card.

questions.label: What is the buyer's father's / husband's full name?
questions.hint: Required for statutory Form 30 records.

questions.label: What is the buyer's present residential address and PIN code?
questions.placeholder: e.g. Flat 402, Shanti Vihar, Janakpuri, New Delhi - 110058
questions.hint: New Smart Card RC will be dispatched to this address via Speed Post.

questions.label: What is the agreed sale consideration value (₹)?
questions.hint: Enter agreed purchase amount for Form 29 sale declaration.

questions.label: Is there an active bank loan or hypothecation on the vehicle?
options: Yes, currently financed (Financier Form 35 NOC attached)
questions.hint: If financed, Form 35 and bank clearance NOC must be submitted.

plan: Step 1: Vehicle & RC Record Verification (Forms 29 & 30 initialized)
Step 2: Buyer e-KYC, Address & Financier Clearance Validation
Step 3: Upload Mandatory Vehicle, Insurance & Identification Proofs
Step 4: Statutory Transfer Fee & Speed Post Delivery Payment (₹530)
Step 5: RTO Officer Scrutiny & Dispatch of Updated Smart Card RC
documents: Form 29 (Notice of Transfer of Ownership in Duplicate)
Form 30 (Application for Intimation & Transfer of Ownership)
Financier Form 35 NOC (if vehicle is financed)

license-renewal.label: Driving Licence Renewal
license-renewal.description: Renew your existing driving licence before or after expiry under MoRTH Sarathi regulations.

questions.label: What is your existing Driving Licence (DL) number?
questions.hint: Enter the 16-character alphanumeric DL number from your card.

questions.label: What is your date of birth as recorded on your licence?
questions.hint: Must match the date of birth in Sarathi database.

questions.label: Which state and RTO issued your driving licence?
questions.hint: Select your parent licensing authority.

questions.label: What category of licence are you renewing?
options: Non-Transport (MCWG - Motorcycle & LMV - Light Motor Vehicle)
questions.hint: Commercial transport licences require Form 1-A medical certification.

questions.label: What is your licence validity / expiry timeline?
options: Expired more than 1 year ago (May require driving skill re-test)
questions.hint: You can apply for renewal up to 1 year in advance of expiry.

questions.label: What is your current age category?
options: 40 years of age and above (Form 1-A Medical Certificate Required)
questions.hint: Applicants aged 40+ require Form 1-A signed by a registered doctor.

questions.label: Physical Fitness Self-Declaration (Form 1)
options: I declare I am physically fit with sound vision & hearing (Form 1 Self-Certified)
I require special optical / prosthetic driving assistance
questions.hint: Self-declaration of physical ability to operate motor vehicles safely.

questions.label: What is your blood group?
questions.hint: Printed on your smart card DL for emergency medical response.

questions.label: Do you wish to pledge for Organ Donation upon accidental death?
options: Yes, I proudly pledge to donate my organs (Reflected on DL)
questions.hint: Government of India organ donor initiative.

questions.label: Do you want to retain or update your residential address?
options: Retain existing address as recorded in Sarathi
Update to new residential address (Proof of address attached)
questions.hint: If updating address, valid proof of new address must be uploaded.

plan: Step 1: Sarathi DL Record & Bio-Metric Identity Verification
Step 2: Medical Fitness Assessment (Form 1 & Form 1-A Doctor Certificate)
Step 3: Upload Existing DL, Medical Forms, Address Proof & Photograph
Step 4: Online Renewal Fee & Smart Card Delivery Payment (₹400)
Step 5: RTO Licensing Officer Approval & Dispatch of Renewed Smart DL
documents: Form 1-A (Medical Certificate signed by Registered Medical Practitioner)
Proof of Present Residential Address (Aadhaar / Voter ID / Passport)
